name: Draw.io
description: Draw.io is a free diagramming application for flowcharts, architecture maps, network diagrams, UML, entity relationships, mind maps, wireframes, and technical schematics. People use its online and desktop editors to create editable visual models without storing diagram data in a Draw.io account.
agentUseSummary: Enable Draw.io once with no login or API key, then let agents create interactive editable diagrams or search the public shape library through the official hosted MCP.

capabilities.label: Create interactive diagrams
capabilities.description: Create editable draw.io diagrams from Mermaid or native draw.io XML and return them as interactive MCP resources.

capabilities.label: Search the shape library
capabilities.description: Find exact styles and dimensions across draw.io's public cloud, network, engineering, infrastructure, and interface shape libraries.

allowed.label: Create diagrams and find shapes
allowed.description: Create one interactive draw.io diagram or search the public shape library through the official hosted MCP.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Diagram generation and public shape search run directly because Draw.io stores no account data and the hosted MCP persists nothing.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Both public Draw.io MCP tools run directly; exact tool allowlists, live schemas, bounds, audits, and credential rejection still apply.
